findings.title: Content Hidden Behind Client-Side JavaScript (CSR)
findings.evidence: Raw server-rendered HTML contains only 21 visible words with 0 script tags. AI crawlers that do not execute JavaScript will see a near-empty page.

suggested_action.summary: Adopt Server-Side Rendering (SSR) or Static Site Generation (SSG) for key entity/product pages so facts exist in the raw HTML response.

findings.title: Missing Machine-Readable Structured Data (JSON-LD)
findings.evidence: Found 0 valid <script type='application/ld+json'> blocks on https://example.com. AI search crawlers cannot deterministically extract entities or facts.

suggested_action.summary: Add Schema.org JSON-LD markup (Organization at minimum, plus Product/FAQPage/Article where relevant) so AI engines can extract unambiguous facts.

findings.title: Missing Temporal & Freshness Metadata
findings.evidence: https://example.com exposes no article:modified_time meta tag, Last-Modified HTTP header, or dateModified/datePublished schema field. AI search engines cannot verify content recency.

suggested_action.summary: Publish machine-readable ISO-8601 timestamps in OpenGraph and Schema.org dateModified metadata on all dynamic and catalog pages.

findings.title: Missing Canonical URL Declaration
findings.evidence: Page does not declare a <link rel='canonical'> tag. Inconsistent URLs may cause conflicting knowledge citations across AI engines.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential <link rel='canonical' href='https://...'> in <head> to establish single-source-of-truth URL indexing.

findings.title: Sitemap Missing or Invalid
findings.evidence: https://example.com/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404 or is not a valid XML sitemap.

suggested_action.summary: Publish a valid sitemap.xml at the domain root and reference it in robots.txt.
